metadata_caption:
FULL REVIEW: https://tinyurl.com/sonylinkbuds

For the most part, I tend to be somewhat underwhelmed by Sony products - not this time! XM3 sounded OK but fit horribly, and XM4 were OK but again awkward fitting and overpriced.

The LinkBuds are also expensive for what they are, but they are the first Sony release that genuinely offer true innovation, filling a gap in the market for those who don't fancy the invasiveness of silicone tips. The call quality is outrageously good, and open design and warm sound signature make them ideal for so many use cases, and with a wide array of accessories, they aim to fit any ear without compromising stability.

The app is full of features, wide area control is ace! Battery life is disappointing though, especially when used for calls, so don't buy for long Zoom or Teams sessions, but if you're looking for good exercise buds that don't thud, don't feel invasive, and can double-up as excellent outdoor call companions, whilst still providing very good, balanced sound, the LinkBuds are your answer.
